fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: false: no quotes (resting quotes are cancelled)

fields.name: window_s
fields.doc: window length in seconds; the slot pair of the window starting at S is (S / window_s) mod pairs

fields.name: clip_shares
fields.doc: shares per quote

fields.name: inv_max_shares
fields.doc: net shares (Up minus Down of the current window) that the long side's next clip, filled completely, may not exceed

fields.name: p_min
fields.doc: lowest bid price quoted, as a fraction of one (1e-9)

fields.name: p_max
fields.doc: highest bid price quoted, as a fraction of one (1e-9)

fields.name: sigma_min
fields.doc: minimum implied volatility per square-root second to quote (1e-9; 0.5 bp = 50_000)

fields.name: sigma_scale
fields.doc: implied over reference realized volatility (1e-9; 1.39 = 1_390_000_000)

fields.name: min_rem_sd
fields.doc: minimum remaining standard deviation to quote, implied sigma times sqrt(seconds left) (1e-9)

fields.name: fv_cancel
fields.doc: fair-value move since placement (fraction of one, 1e-9) that cancels a quote; 0 = off

fields.name: fv_cool_ms
fields.doc: no new quote on a leg for this long after its fair-value cancel

fields.name: stop_before_ms
fields.doc: no quotes this close to the window end

fields.name: vol_window_s
fields.doc: one-second returns in the realized volatility

fields.name: vol_min_samples
fields.doc: one-second returns required before quoting

fields.name: requote_ms
fields.doc: minimum engine time between two quote changes of one leg

fields.name: max_rest_ms
fields.doc: resting limit of every quote (OMS ages it out)

fields.name: pair_margin
fields.doc: a bid that would complete Up/Down pairs rests at most at 1 − (other side's average cost) − pair_margin (fraction of one, 1e-9); negative: pairs may lock at a loss of up to −pair_margin

fields.name: nochase_ms
fields.doc: no new quote on a leg for this long after it was cancelled for being undercut; 0 = off

fields.name: streak_k
fields.doc: fills of one leg that start a streak pause; 0 = off (minimum 2 when on)

fields.name: streak_window_ms
fields.doc: the last `streak_k` fills of a leg within this window pause the leg

fields.name: streak_pause_ms
fields.doc: the paused leg places nothing until this long after its last fill

fields.name: max_window_cost
fields.doc: bought cost of the current window (both legs) at which no new quote is placed; 0 = no limit

fields.name: stuck_reset_ms
fields.doc: a cancel unanswered (no terminal order update) for this long is sent again and the leg is treated as having no quote

fields.name: fv_limit
fields.doc: true: bids are capped by the strategy's own fair value of the Up token (anchored to the Up mid, moved by the reference, inventory and the direction forecast); false: v5 rules

fields.name: fv_anchor_ms
fields.doc: half-life of the fair value's anchor to the Up token mid

fields.name: fv_edge
fields.doc: bids rest at most at the fair value minus fv_edge (fraction of one, 1e-9)

fields.name: fv_hyst
fields.doc: a resting bid more than this above its fair-value limit is cancelled (fraction of one, 1e-9)

fields.name: inv_skew
fields.doc: fair-value limit shift per unit of (Up − Down) / inv_max_shares (fraction of one, 1e-9)

fields.name: pred_k
fields.doc: forecast drift of the fair value: pred_k × forecast × reference sigma × sqrt(30 s) (1e-9)

fields.name: pred_w_imb
fields.doc: forecast weight of the reference level-1 imbalance (bid − ask quantity) / (bid + ask) (1e-9)

fields.name: pred_w_ret
fields.doc: forecast weight of the last 5 one-second returns in sigma units, sum / (sigma × sqrt 5) (1e-9)

fields.name: pred_w_ser
fields.doc: forecast weight of the 15 s signed efficiency, sum / sum of absolute one-second returns (1e-9)

fields.name: comp_skip
fields.doc: a token whose composite direction score is below −comp_skip is not quoted (its resting bid is cancelled); score in standard deviations (1e-9); 0 = off; negative: only a token whose score is above −comp_skip is quoted (directional maker)

fields.name: comp_dir
fields.doc: a token whose composite direction score is above comp_dir may hold up to dir_cap_shares net (instead of inv_max_shares); 1e-9 standard deviations; 0 = off

fields.name: dir_cap_shares
fields.doc: net-share cap of a token whose score is above comp_dir

fields.name: comp_every_ms
fields.doc: the composite score is recomputed at most this often (UTC time)

fields.name: comp_flow_min_shares
fields.doc: prints of at least this many shares count in the score's 30 s flow feature

fields.name: comp_excl_own
fields.doc: true: the strategy's own resting bids are taken out of the bid sizes of the score's imbalance features (they are in the venue's public book); false: not (a simulated account)

fields.name: comp_imb1_mu
fields.doc: score normalization: mean of the best-bid size imbalance of the token and its complement (1e-9)

fields.name: comp_imb1_sd
fields.doc: score normalization: standard deviation of the best-bid size imbalance of the token and its complement (1e-9)

fields.name: comp_imb5_mu
fields.doc: score normalization: mean of the 5-cent bid depth imbalance (1e-9)

fields.name: comp_imb5_sd
fields.doc: score normalization: standard deviation of the 5-cent bid depth imbalance (1e-9)

fields.name: comp_mom30_mu
fields.doc: score normalization: mean of the token mid change over 30 s (fraction of one) (1e-9)

fields.name: comp_mom30_sd
fields.doc: score normalization: standard deviation of the token mid change over 30 s (fraction of one) (1e-9)

fields.name: comp_mom60_mu
fields.doc: score normalization: mean of the token mid change over 60 s (fraction of one) (1e-9)

fields.name: comp_mom60_sd
fields.doc: score normalization: standard deviation of the token mid change over 60 s (fraction of one) (1e-9)

fields.name: comp_bret15_mu
fields.doc: score normalization: mean of the reference return over 15 s in implied-sigma units, signed for the token (1e-9)

fields.name: comp_bret15_sd
fields.doc: score normalization: standard deviation of the reference return over 15 s in implied-sigma units, signed for the token (1e-9)

fields.name: comp_bret60_mu
fields.doc: score normalization: mean of the reference return over 60 s in implied-sigma units, signed for the token (1e-9)

fields.name: comp_bret60_sd
fields.doc: score normalization: standard deviation of the reference return over 60 s in implied-sigma units, signed for the token (1e-9)

fields.name: comp_flow30_mu
fields.doc: score normalization: mean of the signed log1p of the 30 s net taker flow in large prints (shares) (1e-9)

fields.name: comp_flow30_sd
fields.doc: score normalization: standard deviation of the signed log1p of the 30 s net taker flow in large prints (shares) (1e-9)

fields.name: comp_bdrop1_mu
fields.doc: score normalization: mean of the best-bid change over 1 s in cents (1e-9)

fields.name: comp_bdrop1_sd
fields.doc: score normalization: standard deviation of the best-bid change over 1 s in cents (1e-9)

fields.name: load_gate_ns
fields.doc: no quoting while the previous UTC minute's median of the per-second 90th percentile of the slot books' and trades' feed lag (kernel receive − venue time) is at least this (ns); 0 = off

fields.name: mdslow_gate_ns
fields.doc: no quoting while the previous UTC minute's median of the per-second median feed lag is above this (ns); 0 = off

fields.name: dir_pair_free
fields.doc: true: a token whose composite score is above comp_dir completes pairs without the pair-cost limit (two-mode rule: the favoured side pairs off inventory left on the other side)

fields.name: tilt_z
fields.doc: a token whose composite score is above tilt_z quotes tilt_clip_shares per order instead of clip_shares (the side the score leans to is bid in larger size); 0 = off

fields.name: tilt_clip_shares
fields.doc: order size of a token whose score is above tilt_z; 0 = off

fields.name: late_hedge_ms
fields.doc: last-minute stop-loss: from stop_before_ms until late_hedge_ms before the window end only pairing bids are placed, by the leg whose score is above late_hedge_z (the signal is against the net position), at the best bid without the pair-cost limit; 0 = off

fields.name: late_hedge_z
fields.doc: score the pairing leg needs in the last-minute stop-loss

fields.name: mm_min_path
fields.doc: opening rules (schema v9; a leg "opens" when it is not short, i.e. a fill would raise the net; pairing bids are never affected; a token the score favours (z > comp_dir) is exempt): no opening while the Up mid travelled less than mm_min_path over the last 60 s (quiet, drifting market); 0 = off

fields.name: mm_max_bq
fields.doc: no opening on a leg whose best-bid size is above this many shares (long queue); 0 = off

fields.name: early_ms
fields.doc: in the first early_ms of the window the opening net cap is early_cap_shares; 0 = off

fields.name: early_cap_shares
fields.doc: opening net cap in the first early_ms

fields.name: open_min_px
fields.doc: no opening on a leg whose best bid is below this price (cheap side); 0 = off

fields.name: open_skip_z
fields.doc: no opening on a leg whose composite score is below -open_skip_z (it may still pair); 0 = off

fields.name: absorb_shares
fields.doc: inventory absorption (schema v10): of a net position on the other token, the first absorb_shares count as directional; beyond them a token skipped by comp_skip still bids to pair the excess (pairing only, pair-cost limit as usual); 0 = off

fields.name: open_max_px
fields.doc: (schema v11) no opening on a leg whose best bid is at or above this price (expensive side; same exemptions as the other opening rules); 0 = off

fields.name: pair_stop_ms
fields.doc: pairing priority: until pair_stop_ms before the window end a leg that is short bids to pair (pair-cost limit as usual) regardless of the volatility and venue-load gates, the fair-value limit and cancel, the cooldowns and the streak pause, also inside stop_before_ms; 0 = off

fields.name: pair_prio_age_ms
fields.doc: (schema v12) pairing priority only while the window is younger than this (early pairs earn, late ones are adversely selected); 0 = the whole window

fields.name: pair_late_ms
fields.doc: from this window age on, a pairing bid uses pair_late_margin instead of pair_margin (a favoured token with dir_pair_free and the last-minute stop-loss are not affected); 0 = off

fields.name: pair_late_margin
fields.doc: pair margin from pair_late_ms on (fraction of one; 1 = no pairing bids)

fields.name: pair_late_all
fields.doc: (schema v13) true: from pair_late_ms on the favoured token's pairing bid (dir_pair_free) also uses pair_late_margin (no late pairing at any price)

fields.name: fast_until_ms
fields.doc: (schema v14) early fast phase: while the window is younger than fast_until_ms the quote change interval is fast_requote_ms and, with fast_free, no no-chase cooldown and no streak pause (the fair-value cooldown stays); 0 = off

fields.name: fast_requote_ms
fields.doc: quote change interval in the fast phase

fields.name: fast_free
fields.doc: true: no no-chase cooldown and no streak pause in the fast phase

fields.name: fast_pair_only
fields.doc: (schema v15) true: the fast phase applies only to a leg that is short (its bid pairs); opening legs keep requote_ms, the no-chase cooldown and the streak pause

fields.name: fast_dir_from_ms
fields.doc: (schema v16) from this window age on the leg the composite score favours (comp_dir) uses the fast-phase settings (fast_requote_ms, fast_free); 0 = off

fields.name: bid_offset_c
fields.doc: (schema v17) a leg that is not short bids this many cents below the best bid; 0 = at it

fields.name: open_min_imb
fields.doc: (schema v18) a leg that is not short does not quote while its best-bid size over that plus the other token's best-bid size (the mirrored ask) is below this (1e-9); 0 = off

fields.name: bid_improve_c
fields.doc: (schema v19) bid this many cents above the best bid while that stays below the best ask (a new level at the front of the queue); with bid_improve_short only for a short leg; 0 = off

fields.name: bid_improve_short
fields.doc: true: bid_improve_c applies only to a leg that is short

fields.name: dir_lock
fields.doc: (schema v20) true: once one token's net exceeds inv_max_shares in a window (a directional position), the other token is not favoured for the rest of that window

fields.name: fav_max_px
fields.doc: favoured leg that is not short does not quote while its best bid is at or above this (fraction of one, 1e-9); 0 = off

fields.name: fav_pair_cap
fields.doc: favoured pairing (dir_pair_free) may lock pairs at a cost up to 1 + this (1e-9); 0 = no limit

fields.name: dir_phase_ms
fields.doc: (schema v21) one direction per phase: the window splits at this age into [0, it) and [it, end); in each phase the first token the composite score favours is the only one favoured until the phase ends (one reversal per window at most); 0 = off; the window length = one phase

fields.name: comp_always
fields.doc: (schema v22, research export) true: the composite score is kept current while the strategy does not quote too (every window, every second of it); decisions read it only while quoting

fields.name: comp_dir_max
fields.doc: (schema v23) a token is favoured only while its score is at most this (1e-9 standard deviations; over-extended signals are weaker); 0 = no upper bound

fields.name: dir_fresh_ms
fields.doc: a token is favoured only within this long after its score last rose above comp_dir in the window (a fresh signal); 0 = no limit

fields.name: open_min_bq
fields.doc: (schema v24, mature-level admission) a leg that is not short places a new bid only while the best bid's displayed size less our own is at least this many shares; 0 = off

fields.name: open_min_level_ms
fields.doc: and only while the best-bid price has been unchanged for this long; 0 = off

fields.name: pair_min_bq
fields.doc: the same two thresholds for a short (pairing) leg; 0 = off

fields.name: leave_bq
fields.doc: a resting bid of a leg that is not short at the best bid is cancelled when the level's displayed size less our own falls below this many shares; 0 = off

fields.name: fav_obey_open
fields.doc: true: the favoured leg obeys the opening rules too (no exemption)

fields.name: hold_thin_undercut
fields.doc: true: an undercut cancels only when the new best bid is mature (size at least undercut_min_bq, or unchanged for undercut_min_level_ms, or we have been below it for hold_below_max_ms)

fields.name: swept_pause_ms
fields.doc: a fill whose price level disappears within 1 s (swept) pauses the leg's opening and adding for this long; pairing during the pause is limited to cost 1 + swept_pair_cap; 0 = off

fields.name: oth_up_cancel
fields.doc: true: the complement's best bid or ask moving up cancels this leg's bid when it is not short and pauses it for oth_up_cool_ms

fields.name: settle_ms
fields.doc: (schema v25, rule 12 settlement-window liquidity) in the last settle_ms of the window, while the main rules have no target, rest a post-only bid at the best bid of the token the locked settlement-average probability favours (held to settlement); 0 = off

fields.name: settle_p_min
fields.doc: lowest locked-average probability of the favoured token to bid (1e-9)

fields.name: settle_bid_lo
fields.doc: price band of the module's bid, lowest and highest (fraction of one, 1e-9)

fields.name: settle_clip_shares
fields.doc: shares per module bid

fields.name: settle_max_shares
fields.doc: shares the module buys per window at most (a new bid needs bought + clip within it)

fields.name: settle_vol_mult
fields.doc: multiplier of the reference realized sigma in the probability (1e-9; 1.3 = 1_300_000_000)

fields.name: settle_cancel_p
fields.doc: a module bid is cancelled when its token's probability falls below this (1e-9)

fields.name: settle_min_lock_s
fields.doc: no new module bid before this many seconds of the settlement average are locked

fields.name: settle_mu_min
fields.doc: no new module bid while the expected relative move of the average against the strike is below this in absolute value (1e-9; 0.5 bp = 50_000)

fields.name: settle_requote_ms
fields.doc: minimum engine time between two changes of a module bid of one leg

fields.name: settle_improve
fields.doc: true: bid one cent above the best bid when the spread is at least two cents

fields.name: settle_stop_ms
fields.doc: (schema v26) no module bid in the last this-long of the window (resting ones are cancelled); 0 = to the end

fields.name: dir_from_ms
fields.doc: (schema v27, phased direction) a token can be favoured (directional holding, dir_cap_shares, dir_pair_free) only from this window age on; before it the score only skips and times pairing; 0 = from the start

fields.name: pair_eager_z
fields.doc: lazy pairing: a short leg whose score is below pair_eager_z bids pair_lazy_c cents below the best bid (still under the pair-cost limit); at or above it, it bids at the best bid
